name: Ananya Krishnan
headline: Data Scientist | Machine Learning & Predictive Analytics
summary: Data Scientist with 4 years of experience building machine learning models and data pipelines for e-commerce and fintech applications. Skilled in Python-based analytics, statistical modeling, and translating business problems into data-driven solutions. Strong collaborator with cross-functional product and engineering teams.

responsibilities: Develop and deploy machine learning models for customer churn prediction and demand forecasting
Build ETL pipelines using Python and SQL to process large transactional datasets
Collaborate with product managers to define metrics and evaluate model performance
Present analytical findings and recommendations to stakeholders through dashboards
Performed exploratory data analysis to identify trends in customer transaction data
Assisted senior data scientists in building classification models for fraud detection
Created automated reporting scripts to reduce manual reporting time
Maintained data quality checks across ingestion pipelines
Cleaned and preprocessed datasets for internal analytics projects
Supported development of basic regression models under supervision
Prepared visualizations to communicate findings to team leads
